name: @sublay/monorepo
author: Sublay, maintained by Yanay Tsabary
description: Sublay: Build interactive apps with social features like comments, votes, feeds, user lists, notifications, and more.

scripts.react:build-all: pnpm --filter @sublay/core run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/react-js run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/react-native run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/expo run build
scripts.react:publish-prod: pnpm react:build-all && pnpm --filter @sublay/core --filter @sublay/react-js --filter @sublay/react-native --filter @sublay/expo run test && pnpm --filter @sublay/core --filter @sublay/expo --filter @sublay/react-js --filter @sublay/react-native publish --no-git-checks
scripts.react:publish-beta: pnpm react:build-all && pnpm --filter @sublay/core --filter @sublay/react-js --filter @sublay/react-native --filter @sublay/expo run test && pnpm --filter @sublay/core --filter @sublay/expo --filter @sublay/react-js --filter @sublay/react-native publish --tag beta --no-git-checks
scripts.ui-core:publish-beta: pnpm --filter @sublay/ui-core-react-js --filter @sublay/ui-core-react-native run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/ui-core-react-js --filter @sublay/ui-core-react-native publish --tag beta --no-git-checks
scripts.cli:publish-prod: node .github/scripts/check-registry-integrity.mjs && pnpm --filter @sublay/cli run typecheck && pnpm --filter @sublay/cli run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/cli publish --no-git-checks
scripts.cli:publish-beta: node .github/scripts/check-registry-integrity.mjs && pnpm --filter @sublay/cli run typecheck && pnpm --filter @sublay/cli run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/cli publish --tag beta --no-git-checks
scripts.node:publish-prod: pnpm --filter @sublay/node run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/node run test && pnpm --filter @sublay/node publish --no-git-checks
scripts.node:publish-beta: pnpm --filter @sublay/node run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/node run test && pnpm --filter @sublay/node publish --tag beta --no-git-checks
scripts.js:publish-prod: pnpm --filter @sublay/js run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/js run test && pnpm --filter @sublay/js publish --no-git-checks
scripts.js:publish-beta: pnpm --filter @sublay/js run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/js run test && pnpm --filter @sublay/js publish --tag beta --no-git-checks
